note: Distinct section layouts on each page, selected from v5; all original fullBlocks retained and remaining content rendered in the guide before the final CTA.

rules: Never place a single decorative image alone on the right of a short text block with large empty space.
Prefer 2x2 or 3-column card grids for feature lists.
Use split 50/50 only when BOTH sides have substantial content (text min ~120 words OR multi-bullet list).
For process steps use numbered horizontal timeline or compact 3-col cards, not one big photo.
FAQ: full-width accordion, optional small illustration in sticky sidebar only if viewport > 1100px.
CTA bands: full-width dark/lime with optional background image at low opacity, text centered or left with button.

allowed.cardGrid2: 2-column equal cards with optional top icon or small thumb (120px)
allowed.splitEqual: 50/50 text + image only if text is long; image object-fit cover, rounded-xl
allowed.mediaBand: Full-width image 280–360px height with caption overlay, between sections
allowed.iconRow: Horizontal icons + labels, no large photo
allowed.timeline: Horizontal or vertical numbered steps, compact
allowed.stack: Text only, max-width 720px, no side image
allowed.ctaBand: Full bleed dark or lime CTA
allowed.gallery3: 3 equal photos in a row with short captions
